units.source_text: 僧都深恐外人传说他带了这样一个美人来，于他的身份不利，因此凡不曾亲见此事的徒众，他都不告诉他们。

en.t: The bishop was deeply afraid that if outsiders spread word that he had brought such a beautiful woman there, it would harm his standing, so he told none of the disciples who had not seen it with their own eyes.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧也叮嘱大家勿说出去。

en.t: The nun who was his sister also warned everyone not to speak of it outside.

units.source_text: 她深恐有人来寻找，很不放心。

en.t: She was deeply afraid that someone might come looking for the woman, and she could not feel at ease.

units.source_text: 她诧怪这样高贵的人物，怎么会落魄在这种田舍人所居的地方。

en.t: She wondered in amazement how a person of such noble rank could have fallen into a place inhabited by such country people.

units.source_text: 又疑心是入山进香的人在途中患了病，被后母之类的人偷偷地抛弃在那里的。

en.t: She also suspected that the woman might have been a pilgrim going into the mountains to worship, who had fallen ill on the way and been secretly abandoned there by a stepmother or someone of that sort.

units.source_text: 这人除了“把我扔进这条河里去吧”一语之外，并不曾说过别的话。

en.t: Apart from the words, "Throw me into this river," this woman had never said anything else.

units.source_text: 因此妹尼僧非常担心，一心希望她早点恢复健康。

en.t: For that reason, the nun who was his sister was extremely worried and hoped with all her heart that the woman would recover soon.

units.source_text: 然而这人老是昏昏沉沉，全无起色。

en.t: Yet the woman remained constantly dazed and showed no sign of improvement at all.

units.source_text: 她觉得很奇怪，疑心她终无生望。

en.t: She found this very strange and began to suspect that in the end there was no hope of saving her life.
But she could not bear to abandon her and leave her unattended.

units.source_text: 她就把在初濑寺做的梦对人宣说，并请以前曾为这女子祈祷的阿阇梨悄悄地替她焚芥子做祈祷。

en.t: So she told others about the dream she had had at Hase Temple, and secretly asked the acharya who had once prayed for this woman to burn mustard seed and perform prayers for her again.
